version: TRAE v3.6.0 (docs changelog 2026-10-08; not executed). trae-agent 0.1.0 (source read)

facts.claim: Three preset permission modes (Manual Approval, Automatic Approval via LLM Guardian [not in US], Full Access) plus Custom mode via ~/.trae/permission/global.json.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Auto-Run command mode 'always executes outside the sandbox' and 'bypasses all security checks'; 'Automatically Run MCP' toggle lets agent run MCP tools unprompted.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Command execution mode options reported: Always Manual / Use Allowlist / Use Denylist / Always Run.
facts.label: third-party-report

D01.rationale: Granular modes and global.json rules; auto-run bypass is a UI toggle, no repo-level enablement found.

facts.claim: Sandbox for agent commands on macOS, Windows (incl. WSL2), Linux (bubblewrap via Remote SSH); allowlisted prefixes run outside it; project dir except .trae/.vscode/.git writable, root read-only.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Default on/off state of sandbox not stated in pages read.
facts.label: unverified

D02.rationale: Real OS sandbox with configurable FS/network; default state unverified.

facts.claim: Network access is allowed to all networks by default; sandbox.json/global.json support allow/deny (deny wins) for domains, wildcards, IPs, CIDR, ports.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D03.rationale: Allowlist capability exists but default is allow-all.

facts.claim: Project MCP (.trae/mcp.json) requires enabling a toggle with confirmation popup.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Project hooks .trae/hooks.json and imported .claude/settings*.json hooks are supported; no workspace-trust gating statement found.
facts.label: unverified

D04.rationale: MCP gated; hooks/rules from repo have no documented trust gate.

facts.claim: Global MCP in UI; project MCP opt-in; all external MCP connections need explicit authorization first time; mcpRules per server/tool in global.json; 'TRAE does not review MCP servers'.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: MCP transports stdio, SSE, Streamable HTTP; only ${workspaceFolder} variable.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D05.rationale: First-use authorization and per-tool rules; no change-detection documented.

facts.claim: Marketplace of plugins launched 2026-09-20 (TraeCode v3.5.97-3.5.104); Skills page exists; vetting not documented.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: No CLI for the IDE found; cloud agents/scheduled tasks exist inside product.
facts.label: unverified

D08.rationale: N/A (no headless mode for IDE). trae-agent CLI has no approval layer (see extra).

facts.claim: Settings has 'Rules & Memories'; global rules ~/.trae/user_rules, project rules .trae/rules.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D09.rationale: Memory exists; scope and review controls only partially documented.

facts.claim: Subagents page exists; permission inheritance not read.
facts.label: unverified

facts.claim: MCP server logs viewable in Settings > MCP; no audit-log/OTel facts found.
facts.label: unverified

facts.claim: Chat interactions incl. code snippets and AI outputs may be used for analytics/improvement/training unless Privacy mode enabled; Privacy mode only effective when logged in; codebase files not used; indexing uploads plaintext temporarily.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: July 2025 report: ~500 calls / up to 26 MB in ~7 min with telemetry disabled; ByteDance said the toggle only covers VS Code-framework telemetry.
facts.label: third-party-report

facts.claim: Cloud agent stores repo content, rules, MCP, memory, hooks and chat history server-side; promised not used for training.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D12.rationale: Training use default depends on opt-in Privacy mode; third-party evidence of telemetry beyond toggle.

facts.claim: No enterprise/managed policy documentation located; custom permission files are per-user (~/.trae).
facts.label: unverified

facts.claim: bytedance/trae-agent has no SECURITY.md and no GitHub security advisories (API 2026-10-15); no TRAE IDE disclosure program located.
facts.label: unverified

facts.claim: No permission/approval layer: bash tool is a persistent /bin/bash session (120 s timeout); isolation only if run with --docker-* options.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Default config file trae_config.yaml is resolved relative to CWD; contains api keys and mcp_servers; MCP servers only started when listed in allow_mcp_servers.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Trajectories (full LLM I/O) written to trajectories/trajectory_<ts>.json in CWD by default.
facts.label: from-official-docs
